headline: Gold Royalty Corp. Reports Record Financial Results for Q3 2026
summary: Gold Royalty Corp. announced record financial results for the three and nine-month periods ending September 30, 2026, highlighting strong cash flow and earnings growth.
why: Gold Royalty Corp. is a precious metals-focused royalty company that acquires and manages net smelter return royalties and other interests in gold properties, providing investors exposure to gold production without direct operational risks.

impacts.name: Gold Royalty Corp.
impacts.why: The company reported record financial results, which may influence investor sentiment.
